headline: DBM Defends Proposed ₱976-Billion DepEd Budget and 6,587-Classroom Target
seoTitle: DBM Defends ₱976-B DepEd Budget, 6,587 Classrooms | FMB News
seoDescription: The approved FMB News midday brief reports that DBM defended a proposed ₱976-billion DepEd allocation tied to a 6,587-classroom target during House budget scrutiny.
deck: The education spending proposal is being tested against the country's classroom shortage and implementation capacity.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The approved FMB News package reports that budget officials defended a proposed ₱976-billion Department of Education allocation during House scrutiny of the 2027 National Expenditure Program.
The package says the proposal includes financing associated with 6,587 new classrooms and public-private partnership infrastructure.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The figures belong to the proposed 2027 spending plan and are not yet final enacted appropriations. Congress can amend agency allocations before passage of the General Appropriations Act.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: Classroom shortages affect class size, learning conditions and access. The effectiveness of a large appropriation depends on procurement, site readiness, construction capacity and project delivery.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch House budget hearings, DBM tables and DepEd implementation plans for changes to the proposed amount, classroom count and delivery model.
